result.summary: The page is mostly intact, but one visible data/content error stands out: a discount badge showing "-100%" on the lower food card.

issues.description: The badge on the lower pizza card displays "-100%", which is a nonsensical discount value and reads as a calculation or formatting bug rather than a valid offer.
issues.suggestion: Validate the discount value before rendering; show a sensible label such as "100% off" or "Free", and hide or correct the badge when the computed value is negative or invalid.
